title: 十三张牌局特效纹理图集
intendedUse: PixiJS 打枪、胜利、金币弹跳的通用粒子纹理；事件、数字和运动由代码控制
prompt: Create a transparent 3 by 2 sprite atlas of six separate reusable game-effect textures for a polished Shisanshui card game: a soft ivory-gold starburst, a compact teal-gold impact ring, three small glowing diamond sparks, a gentle emerald dust puff, a clean gold sweep arc, and a subtle ivory card-glint. Give every cell generous clear space; align one isolated effect to the center of each equal-sized cell with no overlap. Stylized polished casual-game VFX, crisp alpha edges, controlled brightness, no text or numbers.
negativePrompt: background, panels, cell borders, overlapping effects, text, letters, numbers, cards, suits, photorealism, noisy particles, huge bloom, watermark

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match the dedicated game's teal/gold color and polished light quality; effects remain transparent and independently composed.
